unit: observed current scene and task, proposed action, measured pre/post requirement vector
input: current requirement values and declared thresholds
targets: per-requirement repair / damage / stable-pass / stable-fail; unknown masked
mandatory_controls: existing exact geometric evaluation/search with identical information and budgets
mandatory_metrics: full trajectory requirements and total model/tool cost
loss_family: Ordinary masked multiclass CE on measured transitions; no new objective claimed and no optimization run
not_identifiable_here: long-horizon action value from a one-step comparison
whole-room functionality or expert preference from geometric proxies
cross-project generalization from one development family
same_material_trial: Keep reason/action pairing study separate. Effect prediction is a diagnostic of what those models learn; adding a new loss would be a separate ablation with matched data, not an explanation of pairing gains.
